cards.explanation: The answer is where His wisdom and powers came from. The hometown people ask, "Where did this man get such wisdom and miraculous powers?" (Matthew 13:54). The text says they were astonished. I think they were saying it the way you'd say, "Hold on, who gave HIM the recipe?"

The answer is carpenter, friends. The crowd asks, "Isn’t this the carpenter’s son?" (Matthew 13:55). To them, He's the one from the family they know. They name His mother, Mary, and four brothers, so they've clearly got the whole guest list memorized.

The answer is False. After the questions, the text says, "And they took offense at Him." (Matthew 13:57). So they're offended, not honoring Him. Jesus then says, "Only in his hometown and in his own household is a prophet without honor."

The answer is only in his hometown and in his own household, friends. Jesus says, "Only in his hometown and in his own household is a prophet without honor." (Matthew 13:57). He says it right after they take offense at Him. The word "only" is doing a lot of work in that line.

The answer is because of their unbelief, bakers. The text says, "And He did not do many miracles there, because of their unbelief." (Matthew 13:58). Unbelief is the reason, and the verse says so plainly. I think that's a sad line, and I'd rather leave it just as the verse has it.
